notes: Nine ranks, low to high. Reuses mounted, commandRadiusBonus, banner and supreme from the Samurai ladder's shape, and adds one privilege of its own: divingCharge, logged in the stat breakdown as 'Rank: wing dive' to keep it distinct from the unrelated ABL_DIVING_CHARGE card ability (a Knight elite's hex-based ChargeBonus). Wing dive is keyed to altitude lost this activation rather than hexes moved, since a ground charge means nothing to a faction that fights from the air. Ridgeback Runner is the one ground-bound DRG unit and reuses mounted rather than divingCharge; Cinderthroat Siegewyrm is also ground-bound and sits on a privilege-free tier, same as a Knight siege crew.

ranks.title: Hatchling
ranks.description: Newly hatched. Flies low and short.

ranks.title: Ridgeback Warden
ranks.description: Ground-bound scout and handler; rides rather than flies.

ranks.title: Cinder Warden
ranks.description: Siege crew. A gun crew does not fly, and carries no wing dive privilege.

ranks.title: Dominant
ranks.description: Apex of its wing; commands a platoon. Wing dive +300.

privilegeRules.commandRadiusBonus: Added to the unit's command radius for auras and morale recovery.
privilegeRules.banner: Platoon members inside command radius recover +5 additional Morale in the Command Phase.
privilegeRules.divingCharge: 'Rank: wing dive' in the stat breakdown. +ATK once the unit has lost at least DIVE_BONUS_MIN_DROP (1) elevation tier of net altitude this activation; climbing back to a net gain cancels the dive. Flying-only, since elevation advantage in the base pipeline already excludes fliers.
privilegeRules.supreme: Reserved for campaign scale; not used in the vertical slice.
